Product Profile
Bina Dhan 17 is a high-yielding, early-maturing, medium-height, and medium-slender variety developed at BINA, Bangladesh in collaboration with IRRI. Specifically recommended for irrigated mid-early conditions, it stands out as a green super rice, requiring 25-30% fewer inputs such as water and fertilizers, making it a perfect fit for climate-smart agriculture. Additionally, its grains are suitable for puffed rice. Resistance to BLB and sheath blight further add to the advantages of this variety.
